data.name: Tarun
data.gender_notes: Tarun is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit taruṇa, 'young, tender, fresh'. Its root is Sanskrit tṛ (तृ). A classical Sanskrit term for youth. Tarun is a Sanskrit name meaning “Young; tender; fresh”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tarun expresses “Young; tender; fresh”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit taruṇa, 'young, tender, fresh'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tarun total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Young; tender; fresh” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Tarun; such symbolism is interpretive.
